study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Mao et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Mapping early corpus callosum development to identify neurodevelopmental risk

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are explicitly stated: the study aims to construct sex-specific growth curve (normative) models for the corpus callosum in children aged 1–6 and to test whether deviations from these curves can identify atypical development (ASD). The purpose of applying normative modeling is clearly linked to early detection/diagnosis and individualized deviation scoring.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "This study aims to construct growth curve models to characterize the morphological features of the corpus callosum in children aged 1-6 years... we aim to examine the hypothesis that these growth curve models are effective in identifying atypical development associated ASD." ... "offering a promising approach for early, objective ASD diagnosis"

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: For the new normative model (Dataset 1), TDC eligibility criteria are detailed; image quality standards and data completeness checks are specified (CAT12 IQR threshold and manual inspection); and the final sample size and exclusion counts are reported. These satisfy all listed criteria for NEW model construction.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text:
"Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC)..." 
"The inclusion criteria for TDC were the same for both datasets: age between 1 and 6 years; full-term birth... no current or past neurological or psychiatric disorders... neuroradiologists reviewed the T1 and T2 weighted images to exclude..." 
"We first used the CAT12 toolbox... we chose an IQR equal or less than 'C-' as the exclusion criterion, which excluded 12 images. Subsequently... manual inspection... excluded 6 additional images." 
"Fig. 1... Dataset 1 (n = 311) ... Due to low image quality, 16 images were excluded... resulting in... Dataset 1 (n = 295, TDC)..."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and sex are explicitly modeled: sex-specific growth curves are built, with age included as a second-order polynomial predictor. Data are from a single site/scanner for the reference cohort, so site-effects handling is not applicable.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text:
"We constructed sex-specific growth curve models..." 
"we opted for a second-order polynomial function of age to avoid overfitting"

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The source of the reference cohort is specified: data were collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University; Dataset 1 (TDC) used to build the normative model.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "This study utilized two brain imaging datasets collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University. Dataset 1 consists of... 295 typically developing children... used to construct growth curve models."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Primary data collection parameters are detailed for Dataset 1: modality (T1-weighted MRI), sequence (MPRAGE), scanner/manufacturer and field strength (Siemens 1.5T), and acquisition parameters (TR, TE, TI, flip angle, FOV, matrix, resolution).
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "Dataset 1 was acquired using a Siemens 1.5 T MRI scanner... MPRAGE... TR = 1910 ms, TE = 3.06 ms, TI = 1100 ms, flip angle = 15°, FOV = 192×192 mm, data matrix = 256×256, spatial resolution = 0.8×0.8×1.0 mm³."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The study specifies preprocessing/software and steps: CAT12 for image quality, ANTs/Atropos for white-matter masks, FreeSurfer recon-all with substituted masks for subregion volumes, Yuki for midsagittal features, age-specific templates, and manual QC with ITK-SNAP; QC procedures are described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text:
"We first used the CAT12 toolbox..." 
"To obtain the white matter masks... Atropos... (ANTs)" 
"processed the images using FreeSurfer's 'recon-all'... substituted... masks obtained from Atropos..." 
"manual segmentation was performed using ITK-SNAP" 
"we used... 'Freesurfer' and 'Yuki'"

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: For the NEW model, no data partitioning (e.g., held-out test, K-fold CV) within the reference cohort is reported. The modeling uses the full TDC cohort to build growth curves with bootstrap for CI, but no explicit internal validation strategy where test samples are excluded from fitting. Classification cross-validation occurs only in Dataset 2.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "This study employed a cross-sectional design... (1) normative model construction using data from a single scanner, and (2) clinical validation... using data from a different scanner."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The normative model is applied to an independent external dataset acquired on a different scanner, including healthy TDC, to derive percentile-based deviation scores and evaluate generalizability.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text:
"We applied the normative models to this new dataset to derive percentile-based deviation scores for children with ASD and additional TDCs." 
"Both groups were scanned on a different scanner and were not included in the training of the growth curve model."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The study specifies the modeling framework (GAMLSS), the functional form for age (quadratic), distribution family choice (BCT), and references the software ecosystem (R/GAMLSS), with additional details in Supplementary Methods.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text:
"We... utilized Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS)... opted for a second-order polynomial function of age... technical details in Supplementary Methods." 
"The ... GAMLSS framework was used to construct growth curves... we experimented with... P-splines... selected a second-order polynomial..." 
"...compare multiple candidate distributions... including Normal and Box-Cox t (BCT)... BCT... selected as the optimal model..."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: They report quantitative fit criteria for model selection (AIC/BIC) when choosing the distribution (BCT best by BIC), but do not report standard predictive fit/calibration metrics (e.g., explained variance, prediction error, PI coverage) for the reference cohort.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Model selection was based on the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC)... The BCT distribution demonstrated the best performance based on BIC values..."

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: No data partitioning of the reference cohort was performed for model development; therefore, characteristics by partition (train/validation/test) are not applicable per the guide's NA condition.
nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.supporting_text: Not applicable (no partitions used in Dataset 1 normative model).
